Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly stated that the mass number of an atom is the sum of protons and electrons, which is factually incorrect. The mass number of an atom is the sum of protons and neutrons, as electrons have negligible mass and do not contribute significantly to the atomic mass. This fundamental error led to the wrong calculation of the mass, resulting in the incorrect answer of 12 instead of 13.
